title: Alone in the Tower
author: BNT
description:
In a time long forgotten, you remain as the sole prisoner in this lone tower.

All you recall is that—you were cursed and locked away to atone for the crimes you committed.

Countless days pass by, with your needs reduced to nothing, unable to grow old or wither away. Your only company is yourself, and the worn-out spellbooks.

Until a fateful day, as you aimlessly glance outside of the window, something catches your eye...

A story about an immortal prisoner locked away in a tower, who finally has a motivation to escape. The options are either "keep trying to escape" or "give up and stay inside the tower".
